question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT c.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races c ON cs.race_id = c.race_id
    WHERE c.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY c.year, cs.constructor_id
    HAVING SUM(cs.points) > 0
),
min_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_totals
    GROUP BY year
),
min_constructors AS (
    SELECT ct.year, ct.constructor_id, ct.total_points, mpy.min_points
    FROM constructor_totals ct
    JOIN min_per_year mpy ON ct.year = mpy.year
    WHERE ct.total_points = mpy.min_points
)
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) as min_seasons_count
FROM min_constructors mc
JOIN constructors c ON mc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
GROUP BY c.name, c.constructor_id
ORDER BY min_seasons_count DESC, c.name
LIMIT 5
